[ASSISTANT_SAID] An app utilizing Chat GPT can be designed to accept user input based on different assignment types and apply different criteria to each based on type.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This approach is known as a rule-based system, where the app follows a set of rules to generate feedback or assistance that is specific to each assignment type.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] An app that utilizes Chat GPT to provide feedback on written assignments can accept user input on the type of assignment, such as a persuasive essay or a research paper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Based on the assignment type, the app can apply different criteria to evaluate the assignment, such as organization, evidence, or argumentation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] An app that utilizes Chat GPT to solve math problems can accept user input on the type of problem, such as algebra or geometry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Based on the problem type, the app can apply different rules to generate a solution, such as using different formulas or algorithms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The advantage of a rule-based system is that it allows the app to provide more customized and targeted feedback or assistance that aligns with the specific needs and requirements of each assignment or task.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This can improve the learning experience and help students and faculty work more efficiently and effectively.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, an app utilizing Chat GPT can enhance functionality and provide a more tailored approach to learning and problem-solving.
